intro: Howin Kindfeather returns from a test flight with troubling news: Dragonmaw warlocks are enslaving a red dragonspawn. The Wildhammer will not let that happen again.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I did a quick test flight while ye were out. The good news is the armor ye helped me craft for Bassbeak works like a charm!
The very bad news is I saw a group o' them Dragonmaw in the process of enslavin' a red dragonspawn.
You have tae take it out. You'll certainly need friends tae do so. Kill the warlocks holding it down first--that ought tae free it. Then put it out of its misery.
None of them will stand in the way of the Wildhammer.
